subtitle: Catch Fish Build Harbor
promotional_text: Angler Dock: build your fishing harbor, upgrade your boat, and catch rare fish across beautiful ocean areas in this relaxing fishing simulation.
description: Angler Dock is a fishing simulation game where you manage your harbor, upgrade boats, explore ocean areas, and catch fish. Complete real tasks, collect support cards, and expand your fishing empire. Features a fish encyclopedia, shop, world map with multiple areas, and offline gameplay.
app_review_notes: Angler Dock is an offline fishing simulation game. Players manage a harbor, go fishing, catch fish, and upgrade equipment. No sign-in is required.
